But a customer tranche is not a complete measure of construction progress across the New Jersey campus. The available records do not reconcile the project’s original construction milestones with achieved capacity during the target quarter. They therefore establish neither substantial construction trouble nor sufficiently complete adherence to plan to settle the broad claim.
limitations: The assessment depends on an ordinary interpretation of the undefined phrase going badly.

Later construction problems cannot establish that the project was going badly during the selected reporting period.
